titles.title: More Than Just a Male Friend

description:
Yoon Hara receives a breakup notification over gukbap during lunchtime. 

As if the sudden breakup wasn't sorrowful enough, 
the guy who vanished without a word has returned after 6 years.    
A whole 6 years later! 

"Long time no see, Yoon Hara. 

Her damned male friend, Baek Jae-eun.    
Reunited Baek Jae-eun was still dazzling and breathtaking. 

Compared to herself, a shabby aspiring applicant, he sparkled so much   
that she felt as much jealousy as she had missed him. 

"Didn't you miss me?" 

However, hearing that deep voice after 6 years made her realize:   
Her wildly beating heart was telling her it was fine to cross the line right now.    
And that Baek Jae-eun was far too inappropriate to remain just a 'male friend'.
